notes: Option 1: the project has its own UI, the internal 'منصة المنافسات' portal (Nuxt 4 frontend + Django API) under /Users/ar/Development/projects/tenders/portal (read-only; nothing was run, no server started, no external service or Etimad called, no database or tender folder opened). Redrawn from code, not a live screenshot: the page markup is a hand translation of the Vue templates, and the styling is the portal's real CSS copied verbatim (tokens.css + base.css + components.css concatenated into portal.css, plus each component's scoped <style> block), light theme, RTL. Stage, category, verdict and submission-mode labels are the real ones from backend/portal/tenders/choices.py. Drawn as a 1440x900 browser viewport scaled to 1120x700 so the page's own grid breaks as on a normal desktop window. Font: the app loads Readex Pro from Google Fonts; the same family is taken from a local copy (Abber-App assets). ALL DATA IS FICTIONAL: every tender title, agency (names built on 'النموذجية / المثال'), reference number (2600000010xx), date, count, price/total, award rate and the signed-in user ('مدير المنصة', +966500000000) were invented for this image; no real tender, price, proposal text, client or company document is shown. For the owner to decide: the sidebar keeps what the layout code renders, i.e. the product name 'منصة المنافسات', the line 'سمو لتقنية المعلومات' and the portal's own bundled logo (frontend/public/somow-logo.png, copied to logo.png); if the company brand should not appear next to this internal tool, replace/blank those two elements in 1.html and 2.html and re-render. Doubt: the catalog describes the agents (track, pull booklets, draft proposals); the image shows the portal those agents feed rather than an agent run; the agent pipeline itself (tender-skills/: tender-pull, tender-study with its eight study steps, tender-classify, etimad-login) has no UI of its own.
